description: Curated public world tourist live/webcam directory. In-app playable YouTube/embed streams are prioritized; snapshot-only feeds are excluded because they are not continuous video.

collectionMeta.qualityPolicy: verified playback, source trust, positive tourist context, and coordinate availability are scored before ranking.
collectionMeta.sourcePolicy: Only public official/source-site or embeddable tourist webcams are retained; snapshot-only feeds, raw exposed IP camera scanners, and private RTSP feeds are excluded.
collectionMeta.snapshotPolicy: Static or periodically refreshed image-only feeds are removed from the user-facing global CCTV list.
collectionMeta.openWebcamDbStatus: API-key gated via OPENWEBCAMDB_API_KEY; default disabled until terms and attribution are configured.
collectionMeta.insecamStatus: Excluded: unsecured private surveillance camera directory, not suitable for this curated public tourist dataset.
collectionMeta.generationNote: Some source counts can include retained items from previous verified runs when a collector is disabled, API-key gated, or rate-limited during the latest run.
